caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a reddish-brown finish, centered against a plain, light beige background. The table has rectangular drop leaves on either side, a straight-edged tabletop, and four straight legs. The legs are connected by decorative curved brackets and a central turned finial at the base. On the visible right side, there is a small rectangular drawer with a metal pull handle. The surface of the table and its legs display visible wood grain texture, and the overall composition is simple, with the table positioned in the center of the image and no additional objects or background elements.
title: Pembroke Table
